reference_families.people_activity: living, working and moving across changing residential/commercial zones
reference_families.edge_background: updated land-use boundaries, density categories and district seams
reference_families.proves: The metropolitan authority provides zoning plans updated through January 2026, allowing a transect to be derived from real regulatory transitions rather than arbitrary district hopping.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Built form, street life or a photographically coherent route; every stop needs field confirmation.

reference_families.people_activity: inhabiting and contesting changing land-use intensity
reference_families.edge_background: residential, commercial and mixed-use blocks at district seams
reference_families.proves: A March 2026 council action confirms that Surquillo's land-use framework is actively changing now.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Implementation on any selected block or whether the change is visible as architecture rather than paperwork.

reference_families.people_activity: living beside a proposed change from low-density housing to neighborhood commerce
reference_families.edge_background: single block, neighboring homes and consultation boundary
reference_families.proves: The live zoning consultation supplies a precise block-scale change mechanism in Lince rather than an invented compact-city narrative.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Approval, construction or relevance to Pueblo Libre and Surquillo without a deliberately bounded comparative sequence.

reference_families.people_activity: walking, cycling and driving from Jirón Trujillo into the renewed Francisco Pizarro corridor
reference_families.edge_background: historic street, new sidewalks, cycle infrastructure and northern city flow
reference_families.proves: The July 2025 municipal record confirms a contemporary inclusive-mobility layer beginning at Jirón Trujillo.
reference_families.cannot_prove: The present condition of the older pedestrian street or Puente de Piedra itself.

reference_families.people_activity: cleaning, maintaining and learning along Jirón Trujillo and the Backus fabric
reference_families.edge_background: historic façades, former industrial edge and public realm
reference_families.proves: UNESCO volunteer evidence shows the corridor as maintained lived heritage, not only a route to the bridge.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current 2026 maintenance or ordinary unprogrammed use.

reference_families.people_activity: crossing between Rímac and Cercado above river and transport infrastructure
reference_families.edge_background: stone-and-lime piers, iron railings, river, Vía de Evitamiento and Jirón de la Unión continuation
reference_families.proves: The resource description supplies structural and connective detail for a bridge-as-section hypothesis.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current structural condition, traffic pattern or safe stopping point; primary field verification is required.
